svg.title: Index Translator server components, startup
svg.desc: The entry point loads the configuration and runs the preflight check before it starts the app. Preflight probes the llama library in a child process and checks the default model's file, and exits with one message when the machine cannot run the translator. The configuration also gives the app its origin and host rules. The routes are drawn in the next diagram. start: src/server.ts → src/preflight.ts → src/llama-probe.ts.
